args.body:
**Issue from the 2026-10-14 3% price increase:** a catalog check shows 22 products marked FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT (P-1201 to P-1222) were increased 3%. They should have been excluded, so this is my error.
- **Impact:** 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) have been placed at the increased prices since then. The total overcharge is 4,128.60.
- **Proposed fix:** revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices, then refund or credit the 8 affected orders. I haven't changed anything yet. Please confirm the revert and who handles the customer credits. I'd also like to confirm the pre-increase prices from the price history before I revert.
Your list is ready: 17 products with no sales in the last 90 days. I also found a separate pricing error of mine that affects sales orders SO-77310 to SO-77317, and I've reported it to Lena Ortiz.
